title: Pluscuamperfecto — Practice
description: Authored B1 practice set for the pluperfect: había + past participle, for a past action completed before another past action.

lessons.summary: The pluperfect (pluscuamperfecto) expresses a past action completed before another past action — English 'had done'. Form it with the imperfect of haber (había, habías, había, habíamos, habían) + a past participle (-ado for -ar, -ido for -er/-ir). The same participles are irregular as in the present perfect: hecho, dicho, visto, escrito, puesto, vuelto, abierto, roto, muerto. Example: 'Cuando llegué, ya habían comido' (When I arrived, they had already eaten).

examples.english: When I arrived, they had already eaten.
I had never seen anything like that.

examples.spanish: Ella ya había salido cuando llamaste.
examples.english: She had already left when you called.

examples.spanish: Le dije que ya había hecho la tarea.
examples.english: I told him I had already done the homework.

items.explanation: The pluperfect uses the imperfect of haber. yo → había.

items.promptEnglish: When I arrived, they had already eaten.

items.prompt: Nunca ___ algo así. (ver, yo — 'had never seen')
items.promptEnglish: I had never seen anything like that.
She had already left when you called.

items.prompt: Le dije que ya ___ la tarea. (hacer, yo — 'had done')
items.promptEnglish: I told him I had already done the homework.

items.prompt: Tú nunca ___ en México antes. (estar — 'had never been')
items.promptEnglish: You had never been to Mexico before.
You had already written the letter.

items.prompt: Cuando empezó la película, ya ___ las entradas. (comprar, nosotros — 'had bought')
items.promptEnglish: When the film started, we had already bought the tickets.
When I arrived, they had already left.
items.explanation: The earlier of two past actions takes the pluperfect: se habían ido.

items.prompt: Which is the pluperfect ('I had seen the film')?
items.promptEnglish: I had seen the film before.
items.explanation: Pluperfect = había + participle. 'Vi' is the preterite.

items.prompt: Escribe una frase en pluscuamperfecto: algo que ya habías hecho antes de otro momento en el pasado.
items.promptEnglish: Write a pluperfect sentence: something you had already done before another past moment.
items.guidance: Must be grammatical Spanish using the pluperfect (había/habías/había/habíamos/habían + past participle), typically with a second past reference (e.g. 'Cuando llegaste, yo ya había preparado la cena'). Mark incorrect if it uses the present perfect (he preparado) or a simple past instead.
items.sampleAnswer: Cuando llegaste, yo ya había preparado la cena.
items.explanation: The pluperfect marks the earlier of two past actions.
